request: Analyze GSE164401 for PMID 34880498 (Exercise plasma boosts memory and dampens brain inflammation via clusterin.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.assay: bulk RNA-seq of whole hippocampus (SMART-seq v4 + Nextera XT, NovaSeq; STAR GeneCounts) (S6.9.p1)
final.primary_estimand: Effect of runner plasma (RP; pooled plasma from male C57BL/6 mice with 28 d voluntary wheel running) versus control plasma (CP; sedentary standard-cage donors) infused retro-orbitally every 3 d for 28 d into young non-running recipients, on the recipient hippocampal transcriptome (S1.p3, S6.3.p1, Fig. 1a,h)
final.inclusion: n = 8 recipient mice per group (FIG12 Fig. 1h legend); male donors and sex/age matched recipients
planned_contrasts: RP vs CP, hippocampus, no LPS (S1.p3, Fig. 1h; paper: 1,952 DEGs, 61% down / 39% up)
LPS+RP vs LPS+CP, hippocampus (S2.p1, Fig. 2b; separate experiment, case GSE164401_HC_LPS)
final.repeated_measure_unit: none; one hippocampus per recipient mouse
final.paper_method: DESeq2 v1.32 default (built-in) Wald test, ~ treatment (S6.9.p1)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S1.p3 and Fig. 1h define the exercise-plasma estimand on hippocampus with DESeq2 Wald P<0.05 (raw P, no FC rule; n=8/group). The design is a plasma-transfer experiment: recipients did not exercise, so the estimand is the effect of exercise-conditioned plasma, which is the paper's intended exercise comparison. S6.10.p1's padj<0.1 rule applies to the cortex clusterin experiment, not to this one.

checks: DA.p1 names GSE164401 for the bulk RNA-seq
GSE164401_HC_RNAseq_RP_vs_CP.csv columns CP1-8/RP1-8 match GEO titles HC_CP1-8/HC_RP1-8 (Whole HC, treatment CP/RP)

ownership.reasoning: Series supplementary file deposited by the authors; columns map one-to-one onto the 16 hippocampal CP/RP GSMs.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix column CP1 equals the GEO title HC_CP1 without the HC_ prefix (inspect alignment_keys); group from title, consistent with characteristics treatment CP/RP for these 16 GSMs. Other GSMs (BEC scRNA, cortex, LPS experiment) are not in this matrix. key = title with the HC_ prefix stripped (other titles pass through unchanged and do not match the matrix).

matrix.reasoning: All values integer (integer_fraction 1.0), library sums 2.2-37.9 M; data_processing for the 47 HC samples: STAR GeneCounts; paper S6.9.p1 runs DESeq2 on these counts. 27 Excel-mangled date IDs (Mar/Sep genes) dropped by prep script because the original symbols collide (e.g. March1/Marc1).

design.reasoning: Two independent recipient groups, n=8 each (Fig. 1h). Reference CP (control plasma).

candidates.reason_rejected: mislabels all 31 LPS-experiment samples as RP; title is the reliable label

covariance.reasoning: Independent recipient mice, one sample each; no batch, sex or litter recorded in GEO; paper model has treatment only.

method.reasoning: Paper's DESeq2 default Wald on raw counts (S6.9.p1). No independent pre-filter stated, so none applied.

threshold.reasoning: Fig. 1h legend (FIG12): 'Wald tests; P < 0.05' with 1,952 DEGs; raw P kept as stated. BH padj<0.05 reported separately as audit.

caveats: Recipients did not exercise: the estimand is the effect of runner plasma, not of running itself.
Paper's DEG rule is raw P<0.05 without multiple-testing correction; the audit padj count is the stricter figure.

discrepancies.paper: LPS experiment has SAL+SAL, LPS+SAL, LPS+CP, LPS+RP groups
discrepancies.data: characteristics_ch1.1.treatment = RP for all 31 LPS-experiment hippocampus GSMs
27 rows named 2019-03-xx / 2019-09-xx (March/Sept genes) with 2 duplicated IDs

enrichment.reasoning: Paper reports downregulated acute inflammatory response (S1.p3); GSEA on the full Wald ranking tests the inflammation direction. ORA skipped: paper's ORA used the top 250 DEGs, not the threshold list.

final.primary_estimand: Effect of runner plasma versus control plasma on the hippocampal transcriptome of LPS-inoculated mice (LPS+RP vs LPS+CP), read against the LPS effect (LPS+SAL vs SAL+SAL) (S2.p1, Fig. 2a,b)
final.inclusion: SAL+SAL n=8, LPS+SAL n=8, LPS+CP n=7, LPS+RP n=8 (FIG13 Fig. 2b legend)
planned_contrasts: LPS+RP vs LPS+CP (S2.p1, Fig. 2b; count not stated in text, Supplementary Table 4)
LPS+SAL vs SAL+SAL (S2.p1; paper: 4,936 DEGs; LPS effect, non-exercise reference for the reversal)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: S2.p1 / Fig. 2: RP reverses LPS-induced hippocampal genes (r=-0.78); DESeq2 Wald P<0.05.

checks: 31 columns equal GEO titles of GSM5625049-79 exactly

ownership.reasoning: Author-deposited series file; exact title match for all 31 columns.

alignment.reasoning: Exact match of matrix columns to GEO title. Group from title prefix; GEO treatment field is wrong (all 'RP') and is not used. _1/_2 suffix columns are not technical replicates (log-CPM Spearman: a column's nearest neighbour is usually another L index), consistent with the paper counting them as separate mice.

matrix.reasoning: Integer counts (integer_fraction 1.0), library sums 5.5-50.9 M, STAR GeneCounts (data_processing), DESeq2 in paper. Same 27 Excel-mangled rows dropped.

final.analysis_type: multi-group, planned contrasts from one model

design.reasoning: Four-arm one-way design; the exercise-plasma contrast is LPS+RP vs LPS+CP (CP is the paper's plasma control). LPS vs saline is the paper's reference contrast for the reversal analysis, not an exercise effect. Fitted from one model on all 31 samples.

candidates.reason_rejected: paper's exercise comparison uses CP as control (Fig. 2b)

covariance.reasoning: The L index (L1-L16) in titles is nested within group (each L belongs to one arm), so it cannot be adjusted for as a fixed effect without absorbing the treatment; the paper does not model it. Independent mice treated as units. (Not passed to the confounding report because it is not a metadata column; nesting checked by hand from titles: L1,5,9,13=SAL+SAL; L2,6,10,14=LPS+SAL; L3,7,11,15=LPS+CP; L4,8,12,16=LPS+RP.)

deviations: pydeseq2; one dispersion fit across all four arms (paper likely did the same with a 4-level factor; not stated)

caveats: LPS+SAL vs SAL+SAL is the LPS effect, reported only as the paper's reference for reversal, not as an exercise effect.
Paper does not state the LPS+RP vs LPS+CP DEG count in the text.
